'''Force Sustenance''' was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] used to replace normal needed intakes for life that was employed by the cloistered [[Mind Walkers]] and others.

Darth Bane used this power to no longer have to eat [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], instead using his deep connection to the dark side to sustain himself.<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>  A thousand years later, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would learn a similar way of using the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] by the time he became a Jedi Master.<ref name="DE1">[[Dark Empire 1|''Dark Empire'' 1]]</ref> 

It allowed users to sustain themselves with nothing but the essence of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The forsaking [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Qwallo Mode]] used this technique to fire a missile launcher at the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', without wearing a helmet, while floating in the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The technique's power could be amplified through the exercises of [[Mind Walking]], as evidenced by [[Rhondi Tremaine|Rhondi]] and [[Rolund Tremaine]]'s combined usage of these Force powers.
